title: Multithreaded Sum
description: Write a Zig program that computes the sum of an array using multiple threads.
hints: Use `std.Thread.spawn` to create a new thread running a function
Thread functions receive a context parameter with arguments
Use `.join()` to wait for a thread to finish and get its return value
